reply_text:
I answered Pree in a thread on her #central-team message: the Marrow Agrisupply store was **Pine Crossing**.

The source is her own June 9 post in #central-team. She wrote that the morning receiver at Pine Crossing said the appointment screen only showed the afternoon shift. A driver had arrived at 7:10, and the store wrote his trailer number on a sticky note. Hollis replied that he'd check the shift template and have support try to reproduce it with the store login.

I didn't find a site code or address for Pine Crossing in the channels and files Pree can see. I told her she'd need to get that from the account records if the sheet needs it.
